description: This is a Python source file configuring environment variables and application settings for the Backend Service. It defines a Settings dataclass, loads environment variables with defaults, and provides a cached function to access the settings.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A dataclass encapsulating configuration settings for the backend service, including server parameters, directory paths, and feature toggles.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads and returns the application settings, utilizing environment variables with default values, and caches the result for efficiency.
